# gdrive_folder (Resource)

A folder inside a Shared Drive. Destroy moves it and its contents to trash; permanent deletion is not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gdrive_folder" "documents" {
  name                = "Documents"
  parent_id           = "SHARED_DRIVE_ID"
  description         = "Engineering documentation"
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Folder name.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent folder or Shared Drive root ID. Moves across drives are not supported.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Blocks deletion. Apply false in a separate operation before destroying this resource.
- `description` (String) Folder description. An empty string clears it.

### Read-Only

- `drive_id` (String) Shared Drive containing the folder.
- `id` (String) Google Drive resource ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import gdrive_folder.documents FOLDER_ID
```
